description: Thyroid function test, chosen for its metadata and non-numeric edge cases. 'Age/Sex : 3 M / Male' is a three-MONTH-OLD infant -- the fixture that justifies keeping ReportMeta.age a string, since coercing '3 M' to the integer 3 would silently age the patient by three years. 'Not Done' must land as unparsed rather than being read as a number or dropped. Anti-TPO '>1000' is a one-sided value bound against a one-sided reference bound. T3 Total uses times-ten notation (1.2 x 10^2 = 120) that sits INSIDE its 80-200 range, so a normalizer that fails to expand the exponent would wrongly flag 1.2 as critically low.

lines.text: Remarks: Subclinical hypothyroidism. Repeat after 6 weeks.
